card.name: Web browsing and links wording
card.fires_on: Words in web-related general text about websites, links, search engines or browsing, usually a verb or noun right after a web subject (surf, click, display, point, user, robot).

modes.label: Verb after web subject
modes.description: A verb describing what a user, link or page does online.

modes.description: A noun completing a phrase about search engines, bots or tools.
